name: Partaloa (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided olive green over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Partaloa (a bend on blue and a horse on green).
history: Partaloa was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía on 25 March 2002 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until March 2009; the flag is a rectangular cloth twice as long as wide, divided into two halves, olive green above and white below.
